timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Thank you very much for coming here to the Vazcantis of Foltsha for coming here and I would like to ask you as a member of the IRSP.
If you can trace the history of your own party from the creation until now.
Our party has formed along the ideals of James Conley. It was set up to promote the labor cause and the social cause.
We take our most of our political aspirations from Conley's writings.
We seek Conley as an inspirational leader in 1916.
The war party was formed in 1974 by Schumann Schustello. We still track our lineage back through Conley today's citizens army.
When they set up their citizens army to defend the workers against the onslaught of the scabs and employers who employed mushrooms.
Do you see the possibility of a United and Socialist Ireland closer now than in the past or not?
No, I see it further away. The partition of Ireland and Art Official State was set up in 1921.
Over the years all Republicans from different persuasions, whether they left or right, have all pushed for an independent 32-county sources Ireland.
In the latter years since the so-called peace processes come online, that has copper-fastened partition.
It has increased sectarianism. If you just look at Belfast, you'll see that peace walls have increased and become more prevalent.
People are more distant-chanted and more disaffected.
We have an increase in political places. We have an increased now in prisoners, which instead of reversing it is increasing.
So on a constant basis, our own members, we had 18 members recently arrested and held for questioning and released without charge.
This is all formal harassment under the new so-called peace process.
What would be the key to bring together both communities?
Both communities, if you analyse them and sit down with them, we have set a party set down in the past with people from the Liar Discard Parmaltrys and Liar Discard.
When you speak to those people, they want the same things in the working-class areas. They want jobs, they want infrastructure, they want housing, they want a decent life for their people.
The ever-shoot public and social party was set up as a non-political and not-sorry, a non-religious sectarian group.
We accept all religions in our party. Some of our former leaders, Ronnie Bunton, were Protestants.
So no, we would open our arms to the working-class of all cultures, all religions in Ireland.
